meta.title: Services from Betty Teklemariam, cultural advisor
meta.description: Guidance, cultural mediation, cultural translation and training around the Eritrean community. For municipalities, healthcare, youth care, education and NGOs.

hero.title: What I do for your organisation
hero.intro: I offer guidance, cultural mediation, cultural translation and workshops for anyone who works or lives alongside Eritrean communities.

begeleiding.name: Guidance
begeleiding.description: Culturally sensitive guidance for Eritrean clients and families, and support for professionals on parenting, family and safety issues.

culturele-bemiddeling.name: Cultural mediation
culturele-bemiddeling.description: Mediation between professionals and Eritrean clients: making language, behaviour, expectations and context understandable for both sides.

culturele-vertaling.name: Cultural translation
culturele-vertaling.description: Cultural interpretation of policy, communication, information campaigns and research, so they land with Eritrean audiences.

workshops-voorlichting.name: Workshops & training
workshops-voorlichting.description: Workshops and training for professionals and teams working with Eritrean communities.

begeleiding.title: Guidance
begeleiding.intro: Professionals call in Betty when a case involving an Eritrean client or family gets stuck. As a social pedagogue, she guides the family herself and thinks along with the team working on it — including around parenting questions, safety concerns and trauma.
topics: Culturally sensitive family and parenting guidance
Strengthening communication between parents and young people
Support around mental health and trauma processing
Making domestic violence, addiction and boundary-crossing behaviour discussable
Thinking along on complex cases
Integration and participation trajectories

culturele-bemiddeling.title: Cultural mediation
culturele-bemiddeling.intro: An invisible gap often opens up between organisations and newcomers. Betty steps in when professionals and Eritrean clients aren't reaching each other, and clarifies what's meant on both sides — in language, but also in behaviour, expectations and context.
topics: Joining conversations with clients and families
Mediating in complex cases
Explaining cultural norms and expectations
Clarifying communication between parties
Restoring trust after miscommunication
Supporting collaboration with families and communities

culturele-vertaling.title: Cultural translation
culturele-vertaling.intro: Policy, information campaigns and research only reach Eritrean audiences if the tone and explanation are right. Betty reviews the material, interprets the cultural meaning behind the words, and says what needs to change — including for taboo subjects where a standard text falls short.
topics: Cultural interpretation of communication and policy
Advice on information materials and projects
Tailored relationship and sex education for young people
Advice on addressing taboo subjects
Support for research and interviews
Thinking along on policy, implementation and research

workshops-voorlichting.title: Workshops & training
workshops-voorlichting.intro: Betty trains teams that work with Eritrean communities. She combines cultural interpretation with 26 years of practice, so a team knows afterwards what it can do differently in a real case.
topics: The Eritrean community in the Netherlands and the migration context
Working with Eritrean status holders
Communication, trust and collaboration
Culture, upbringing, gender roles and family context
Faith, mental health and dealing with trauma
Self-reliance, participation and integration

custom.title: Tailored collaboration
custom.intro: Not every question fits neatly into one of these four services. Betty combines training, advice and guidance where needed, thinks along on individual cases as well as longer trajectories, and tailors the approach to how your organisation works.

werkwijze.heading: How I work
werkwijze.intro: From first question to follow-up, in four steps.

steps.title: Introduction
steps.desc: We discuss your question, who the target group is, and where things are currently stuck.

steps.title: Determining the approach
steps.desc: Together we choose what fits: guidance, mediation, cultural translation or a workshop, or a combination.

steps.title: Execution
steps.desc: Betty carries it out and stays in touch along the way with your team, chain partners or the family.

steps.title: Follow-up
steps.desc: We look back at what it delivered and schedule a follow-up meeting if needed.
